representation.name: Runtime probe sequence toolbox
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
{
  echo python
  python --version
  echo minimap2
  if command -v minimap2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then minimap2 --version; else echo MISSING; fi
  echo samtools
  if command -v samtools >/dev/null 2>&1; then samtools --version | head -n 1; else echo MISSING; fi
} > probe.txt
